highest_confirmed_finding.trigger: Direct SIGTERM to the wrapper while its make|tee pipeline is running
highest_confirmed_finding.impact: Wrapper exits and removes its owned manifest, while build descendants and owned TCP resources remain live and inherited workspace flock remains held, blocking later build calls.
highest_confirmed_finding.fix_scope: A01 runner subprocess/session supervision, INT/TERM forwarding, wait/reap and owned manifest cleanup; retain single group-owner and unreaped leader identity, pipeline/log failure handling, GDB inherited FD>=64, and lock inode semantics.
highest_confirmed_finding.fixture_limit: Copied unmodified runner, dummy make and Python TCP lease child. No real compiler, QEMU or kernel workload executed.

production_manifest.note: Observed only. The mechanism recreating this environment file remains unproven; not attributed to Git or cleanup.

not_claimed: root-cause attribution of external manifest recreation
